RING ATLAS / COMPLETE CENSUS

Case records

1,434,042 fusion rings at ranks 3–12, within the published multiplicity bounds. Every ring has an individual record and a downloadable fusion tensor.

Full census and detailed profiles

The full census includes excluded, modeled and unresolved rings. Detailed profiles add constructions, proofs and research history for 3,460 census rings; two further profiles describe the rank-two realizations, outside this finite census. A basic record without a detailed profile is not an unresolved case.

Census identifiers begin with C; the existing R and F research identifiers retain their meaning and permanent addresses. Exact basis changes connect each detailed profile to its census record. Published bounds and source datasets →
